About me

I'm a Senior Research Scientist in Adobe Research, working on image and video editing. In 2026, I received Adobe's Tech Excellence Award.

I obtained my BS, MS & PhD from KAIST, advised by Prof. Munchurl Kim. During my PhD, I worked mostly on low-level vision, in restoring and enhancing images and videos. I had a great time as a Research Intern, and after that a Student Researcher, in Perception, Google Research in 2020 (Host: Orly Liba). In 2021, I was fortunate to work as a Research Intern at Adobe Research (Mentor: Jianming Zhang). I'm grateful to be a recipient of the Google PhD Fellowship.
